assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: clean terrain plate for a layered landscape game camp, same 16:9 composition.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the owner-approved Overlook painting. Preserve its camera, framing, ledge silhouette, mine entrance in upper left, walkable paths, rope-guarded descending path on the right, foreground rock masses, enormous cavern and entire distant goblin fortress.
Remove ONLY the removable foreground camp furnishings: the patchwork canvas shelter and poles, beds and rugs, barrels/crates/baskets beside it, open stash chests on the left, central campfire including its ring and sitting stones, the survey table and stools, and loose foreground timber/supply boxes. Reveal plausible continuous rough bare slate and existing craggy rock behind them. Remove the local campfire's warm orange pool from the empty ground. Retain the mine's torch and the two routes, and the tiny distant fortress lights. No human figures.
Do not redesign the landscape or fortress. Do not shift any major rock outline or route. Match the same detailed dark gritty painted materials and uneven handworked world, but do not add objects, writing, structures or fantasy symbols. Cool neutral rock at the former campsite. The final image must be a believable empty refuge that matches the approved composition exactly, with no ghost furniture, warm ground hotspot or cropped edges. Opaque full-canvas landscape output.

Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: independent shelter cutout for the approved Overlook camp.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a crop of the selected painting. Isolate the ENTIRE existing patchwork shelter and its own furnishings: crooked timber poles and crossbars, ragged brown canvas, bedrolls, small rug, two barrels and the small supply bin beneath/beside the canopy. Preserve the exact three-quarter elevated camera, roof angles, worn textures, cloth tears and arrangement. Remove every piece of surrounding cavern rock and ground, and remove the partial open chest cut off at the bottom-left edge. Do not add people or furnishings.
Transparent background is required, not black or checkerboard. Retain the object's natural subdued contact shadow only at its feet, no broad floor patch. Whole shelter must fit within the canvas with transparent padding; do not crop poles or roof. Match the detailed dark gritty painterly material style and muted neutral cave lighting. Keep it makeshift, uneven and modest; no clean symmetry, ornate decorations, firelight baked onto surrounding ground or writing.

Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: independent stash/supply chest cutout for a layered Overlook camp.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Isolate the two open rough timber stash chests exactly as arranged: larger front chest and its open angled lid, rear smaller chest, broad imperfect planks, dark iron straps, loop handles, dark cloth contents. Preserve this elevated three-quarter perspective and original asymmetry, scale relationship and weathering. Remove all cavern ground, rocks, tree/poles, surrounding campfire glow and the unrelated barrel in the upper right.
Genuinely transparent background, entire chest group with generous transparent margins and no cut-off lid. Keep only small neutral foot/contact shadows, no floor patch. Muted realistic painted dark-fantasy materials, no gold piles, luxury ornament, people, writing or labels. The chest must feel used and under-resourced, not broken or freshly manufactured.

Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: survey-table camp prop with transparent background.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Extract the existing crooked timber survey table, its legs and cross braces, small stool, two small timber boxes under/beside it, old parchment route sheet, plain cup and map weights. Keep their original relative positions, the same elevated three-quarter camera and right-side tabletop angle. The parchment is weathered and largely blank with indistinct charcoal smudges, no legible writing. Preserve irregular plank ends, worn edges and hand-built proportions, no refined cabinetry. Remove ALL surrounding cavern, rocks and ground; no rectangular floor patch, no extra people, no lantern or luminous marks. Neutral subdued painted cave lighting, small contact shadows only. Complete group on genuinely transparent canvas with margins, nothing clipped.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: unlit campfire furniture layer, genuinely transparent background.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the exact elevated three-quarter arrangement of the rough stone fire ring and the four blocky sitting stones around it. REMOVE all flames, orange glow, embers, surrounding floor and cave rock. In the centre retain dark charred short sticks and ash inside the ring, with no light emission. Keep the sitting stones' individual irregular shapes and spacing from the reference. Dark neutral grey slate, dirty chipped edges, detailed painted dark fantasy materials. This is one independent reusable furniture group, no people, no new props or writing. Fully transparent exterior with natural tiny contact shadows, no opaque ground rectangle. Complete all four sitting stones, ring and charred logs with transparent padding.

Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: loose supply cluster for the foreground of the approved Overlook.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Extract the small rough open timber supply crate with bundled short lengths of firewood and two uneven spare planks leaning diagonally across it. Preserve the low elevated three-quarter view and weathered wood. The entire little cluster should be complete, with modest asymmetry and believable construction, not shattered debris. Remove ALL rock, ground, distant camp parts and orange ground illumination. No weapons, people, labels, badges or new objects. Fully transparent exterior and transparent canvas margins; only tiny neutral contact shadow at its feet. Dark gritty painterly materials matching the selected camp.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: isolated campfire FLAME overlay, transparent background.
Create only a modest low campfire flame mass for the charred logs in the attached Overlook firepit. Input image 1 is a style/scale reference, not the output background. The flame has several irregular tongues, a warm amber/orange outer body and small pale golden core at its base; it is 1.2 times as tall as it is wide. Painterly realistic dark-fantasy fire, restrained, no explosive flare, no flying sparks. Bottom centre is the origin; fully transparent around the flames with soft natural luminous edge. No rocks, logs, coals, smoke, people, floor, backdrop, text or light pool. The whole flame fits with generous transparent margins. It will be animated subtly by a shader and placed on a separate unlit firepit.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: small independent hanging oil lantern for the approved Overlook camp.
Input image 1 is a STYLE reference for worn timber and dark painted materials, not a background to reproduce. Paint one modest old iron oil lantern, its four-sided glass housing viewed from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. Dented irregular dark iron frame, soot-marked cloudy glass, small loop handle on top, low steady wick glow inside. An ordinary practical lamp, not ornate treasure; no symbols or writing. Complete lantern isolated with transparent padding on a truly transparent background. No pole, hook, table, ground, broad halo, people or backdrop. Local glow will be a separate engine layer. Keep its light subdued and the iron readable in the dark.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: full-body seated companion activity, transparent cutout.
Input image 1 is the project-generated Corin appearance reference. Preserve the bald head, broad self-assured face, stocky muscular build, brown padded leather vest and plain off-white shirt. Input image 2 is only a reference for the Overlook's elevated camera and painted materials.
Show this adult man seated on a low invisible seat, feet planted and body turned three-quarter toward the viewer's left. He is calmly checking the buckles and straps of a small plain leather travel pack held across his knees, both hands visibly occupied with a strap. Relaxed concentration, shoulders down, no action gesture. Dark worn trousers and practical boots. Match the camp's roughly 35-degree downward viewing angle and dark gritty painterly finish.
Only the complete man and small pack, on genuine transparent background with margins around all extremities. No seat, rocks, ground, cave scenery, other people, writing, armour ornament or additional equipment. Neutral dim cave lighting. No new identity, costume or portrait system design is requested.

Neutral diffuse cave illumination on the character itself, with fire glow supplied separately by the engine.
